entry.title: Current Open Questions in Complete Mixability
entry.summary: Complete and joint mixability has raised considerable interest in recent few years, in both the theory of distributions with given margins, and applications in discrete optimization and quantitative risk management. We list various open questions in the theory of complete and joint mixability, which are mathematically concrete, and yet accessible to a broad range of researchers without specific background knowledge. In addition to the discussions on open questions, some results contained in this paper are new.

entry.title: Some open questions in analysis for Dirichlet series
entry.summary: We present some open problems and describe briefly some possible research directions in the emerging theory of Hardy spaces of Dirichlet series and their intimate counterparts, Hardy spaces on the infinite-dimensional torus. Links to number theory are emphasized throughout the paper.
entry.arxiv:comment: To appear in the proceedings volume for the conference "Completeness Problems, Carleson Measures, and Spaces of Analytic Functions" held at the Mittag--Leffler Institute in 2015

entry.title: A max-type recursive model: some properties and open questions
entry.summary: We consider a simple max-type recursive model which was introduced in the study of depinning transition in presence of strong disorder, by Derrida and Retaux. Our interest is focused on the critical regime, for which we study the extinction probability, the first moment and the moment generating function. Several stronger assertions are stated as conjectures.

entry.title: Basic Properties of Strong Mixing Conditions. A Survey and Some Open Questions
entry.summary: This is an update of, and a supplement to, a 1986 survey paper by the author on basic properties of strong mixing conditions.

entry.title: Some points on Vervaat's transform of Brownian bridges and Brownian motion
entry.summary: In a recent work J. Pitman and W. Tang defined the Vervaat's transform for a Brownian bridge with two different endpoints and for a Brownian motion between times $0$ and $1$. They proved some path decomposition properties for these Vervaat's transforms and raised open questions on their semi-martingale decomposition. In this paper we give an alternative proof for the path decomposition and answer the open questions.

entry.title: The determinacy of infinite games with eventual perfect monitoring
entry.summary: n infinite two-player zero-sum game with a Borel winning set, in which the opponent's actions are monitored eventually but not necessarily immediately after they are played, is determined. The proof relies on a representation of the game as a stochastic game with perfect information, in which Chance operates as a delegate for the players and performs the randomizations for them, and on Martin's Theorem about the determinacy of such games.

entry.title: Stretched Polymers in Random Environment
entry.summary: We survey recent results and open questions on the ballistic phase of stretched polymers in both annealed and quenched random environments.
entry.arxiv:comment: Dedicated to Erwin Bolthausen on the occasion of his 65th birthday
entry.arxiv:journal_ref: Probability in Complex Physical Systems, Proceedings in Mathematics 11, 339-369 (2012)

entry.title: Relaxation and 3d-2d passage with determinant type constraints: an outline
entry.summary: We outline our work (see [1,2,3,4]) on relaxation and 3d-2d passage with determinant type constraints. Some open questions are addressed. This outline-paper comes as a companion to [5].

entry.title: Off-critical lattice models and massive SLEs
entry.summary: We suggest how versions of Schramm's SLE can be used to describe the scaling limit of some off-critical 2D lattice models. Many open questions remain.

entry.title: Fixed points of continuous rotative mappings on the real line
entry.summary: We show that every continuous rotative mapping on a closed interval has a fixed point. This gives an answer to some open questions raised by Goebel and Koter.

entry.title: Second-order symmetric Lorentzian manifolds
entry.summary: Lorentzian manifolds with vanishing second covariant derivative of the Riemann tensor are studied. Their existence, classification and explicit local expression are considered. Related issues and open questions are briefly commented.
entry.arxiv:comment: 8 pages, Contribution to the Proceedings of the XXVIII Spanish Relativity Meeting, E.R.E.2005 (Oviedo, Spain, 2005)

entry.title: New Results for the Two-Stage Contact Process
entry.summary: Here we continue the work started by Steve Krone on the two-stage contact process. We give a simplified proof of the duality relation, and answer most of the open questions posed in that paper. We also fill in the details of an incomplete proof.
